spans.s:
f. (-ता)
1 A creeper, a creeping or winding plant in general.
2 A branch.
3 A plant, commonly

Priyangu.
4

A gramineous plant, (Trigonella corniculata.)
5 Heart-pea, (Cardiospermum haliacacabum.)
6 The large Bengal creeper, (Gærtnera racemosa.)
7 A sort of grass, (Panicum dactylon.)
8 A vegetable and medicinal substance, commonly Latākastūrī or the musk-creeper, said to grow in the

Dekshin.
9

Thread.
E.
लत a Sautra root, to hurt, to enfold, &c., aff. अच् and टाप्.

f. (-का)
A medicinal plant, commonly Latākastūrī.
E.
लता a creeper, and कस्तूरिका musk.

m. (-ह्वः)
A snake.
E.
लता a creeper, and जिह्वा the tongue, which becomes masc. in the compound.

m. (-रुः)
1 The orange tree.
2 The palm tree.
3 The Śāl tree.
E.
लता a creeper, and तरु a tree: fit for creepers to cling to.

m. (-मः)
A timber tree, (Shorea robusta.)
E.
लता a creeper, and द्रुम a tree.

n. (-न्तं)
A flower.
E.
लता a creeper, and अन्त end.

m. (-सः)
The water-melon.
E.
लता a creeper, and पनस the jack, to the fruit of which the melon may be compared in size.

f. (-नी)
A spreading creeper.
E.
लता a creeper, and प्रतानिनी spreading.

m. (-णिः)
Coral.
E.
लता a creeper, and मणि a jewel.

f. (-रुत्)
A plant, (Trigonella corniculata.)

f. (-बी)
The Mādhavī creeper, (Gærtnera racemosa.)
E.
लता a creeper in general, माधबी the particular one.

m. (-गः)
An ape or monkey.
E.
लता, and मृग a deer.

f. (-ष्टिः)
Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.)
E.
लता a creeper, and यष्टि stick or stem.

n. (-कं)
Coral.
E.
लता a creeper, यावक barley, or similar grain; of similar shape.

m. (-नः)
A snake.
E.
लता a creeper, and रसना the tongue, but made masc. in the compound.

m. (-र्कः)
A green onion.
E.
लता a creeper, and अर्क to heat, aff. घञ्.

m. (-कः)
An elephant.
E.
लता a creeper, and अलक a curl.

n. (-नं)
Embracing, an embrace.
E.
लता a creeper, and वेष्टन surrounding.

n. (-कं)
An embrace, embracing.
E.
लता a creeper, (like it,) वेष्टित a surrounding or enfolding, aff. कन्.

m. (-ङ्घः)
The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) This word is elsewhere read लताशङ्कु or लतातरु and शङ्कुतरु.

f. (-का)
A twining plant.
E.
लता the same, कन् aff. fem. form.

f. (-का)
A lizard.
E.
लत a Sautra root, to hurt, तिकन् Uṇādi aff.
